2. 'texture_anomaly' (Skin surface, Severity 2): I agree. The skin has a uniform, slightly plastic/repetitive look typical of AI generation or low-poly 3D models, lacking organic micro-detail.
3. 'structural_collapse' (Feet/Ground contact, Severity 1): I agree. The feet lack distinct toes/claws and blend into the white background, indicating poor grounding or segmentation boundaries.

No new artifacts were found by experts that contradict the Router. The geometric depth auditor confirmed valid 3D structure for the existing parts, and the topology auditor confirmed a single coherent mask, but these do not negate the missing part.
